content.summary: A courier's charging-stop performance becomes an encounter with a mechanic. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One fixed observer frame establishes person, carrier object and environment before the approach. + The first adult's foreground performance preserves the background spatial anchors. + Retreat to the same carrier converts approach into a stable seated baseline. + A second adult enters from established background geography rather than appearing through a reset. + The final shared frame converts solo display into a readable two-person encounter.
quick_start.recommended_input: Fix one low, slightly tilted wide camera beside an original blue service van at a quiet roadside charging stop. She steps back and sits on the same van bumper, preserving screen direction and camera geometry. Hold both adults, bumper, cable and charger together as the courier turns to the mechanic and the solo performance becomes an encounter.

invariants.rule: One fixed observer frame establishes person, carrier object and environment before the approach.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.

invariants.rule: Retreat to the same carrier converts approach into a stable seated baseline.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Retreat to the same carrier converts approach into a stable seated baseline."

invariants.rule: The final shared frame converts solo display into a readable two-person encounter.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final shared frame converts solo display into a readable two-person encounter."
